_comment: Fake set_constraints turn for the wish extraction (PL2: the heuristic plans, the model only reads the note). A template: replace {{d2}} (a date of the window, YYYY-MM-DD), write the result to a unique path and point the backend at it (PUT /api/settings/ai.fake_script).
The extraction asks for a light dinner on {{d2}}; the run's notes then say it ('Light: ... dinner'). plan-review-llm.spec.ts slows the turn down with delay_ms so the board can show the run.
